children: Bloomberg ETF analyst James Seyffart posted on X a list of institutions holding HYPE spot ETF shares. According to Odaily, Wealth High Governance ranked first with 632,614 shares valued at $23,948,236, followed by OLP Capital Management with $10.5 million in shares. UBS Group ranked third with $7.5 million in assets, Bank of Montreal ranked fourth with $6.7 million, and Jane Street ranked fifth with $4.4 million.

title: Wealth High Governance Tops List of HYPE Spot ETF Holders, James Seyffart Says
